message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files directly into DataFrames and accesses columns by position without any schema checks, dtype assertions, null-value guards, or value-range validations.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is scraped from basketball-reference.com via CSVGenerator without any checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks on the retrieved content.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code reads CSVs and constructs features without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using sklearn (LogisticRegression, SVC, KNeighborsClassifier) and loads only CSV data files; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, and no hash/signature verification is performed anywhere.

No detected label distribution validation: The code reads training and testing CSVs and splits features/labels but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set verification, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, neural cleanse, or any other backdoor defense anywhere in the training loop or helper functions.

No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used; standard scikit-learn pipelines are used without any noise-addition mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing tools (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV files directly into DataFrames and slices columns with no shape, range, type, or schema validation before passing features to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Predictions are consumed directly via accuracy_score, recall_score, etc. with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses classical ML classifiers (Logistic Regression, SVC, KNN), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
